app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Attack: Wield repairable tier-55 Gravite melee weapons.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Strength: Suggested combat readiness target for late F2P encounters; this is a draft choice, not a quest requirement.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Defence: Wear the tier-55 Gud raider chainbody; also covers rune +3, blue dragonhide and mystic armour.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Constitution: Suggested survivability target for late F2P encounters; this is a draft choice, not a quest requirement.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Ranged: Wield the retained tier-70 yew bows, paired with F2P rune arrows.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Prayer: Mystic Might and the Hard Lumbridge Gods, Give Me Strength achievement.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Magic: Fire Blast for the Hard Lumbridge Blast and Hellfire achievement; also covers Gravite magic weapons.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Runecrafting: Craft 100 water runes at once for the Hard Lumbridge Not Waving But Drowning achievement.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Crafting: Make diamond amulets for an amulet of power; also covers blue dragonhide armour and Hard Lumbridge crafting.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Mining: Mine runite for rune equipment and tools.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Smithing: Smelt rune bars and smith rune equipment, including +3 upgrades; item tier 53 does not require Smithing 53.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Fishing: Catch swordfish, a late F2P food milestone.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Cooking: Cook the Hard Lumbridge chocolate cake; also covers swordfish.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Firemaking: Burn a yew log for the Hard Lumbridge Are Yew As Fired Up As I Am? achievement.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Woodcutting: Cut yew logs yourself for the Hard Lumbridge fire and F2P woodcutting milestone.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Fletching: Make acadia longbows; the acadia wood box and shortbow unlock at 50.
app/web/finish-line-model.mjs#skillReaso.Dungeoneering: Suggested rounded training target beyond the level-35 Gravite equipment gate; token costs still apply.
